text:
Priya (CSM): heads-up — Sam Patel from Vercity wants to change payment path for the upcoming renewal (next Wed). they can only issue a PO for 70% of the committed spend, asking if we can accept partial PO + ACH for balance. also asking if onboarding credit can be applied earlier so enablement can run on schedule.
Jordan (Finance): partial PO is possible but we need a payment schedule + deposit. standard is full PO or full ACH/CC. do we have precedent for 70/30 split? :thinking_face:
Priya (CSM): we did a similar split for Nebula last year (70/30) with a 30% deposit. ops provisioned a small set of seats after deposit. legal needs to ok amendment language.
Ari (Legal): @Priya please paste the proposed amendment text here. need to confirm there are no changes to indemnity/liability and that payment remittance and entity are clear. if PO covers only portion, contract should state remaining balance due by X date and provisioning conditions.
Priya (CSM): proposed amendment draft: ```
Amendment: Customer may submit a partial Purchase Order covering up to 70% of the Renewal Commitment. Remaining balance (30%) shall be invoiced and payable via ACH within 30 days of invoice. Provisioning of additional Dedicated seats is contingent on receipt of an initial deposit equal to 30% of the total Renewal Commitment.```
Sam Patel: that reads fine to us. CFO prefers ACH for the remainder. we can sign the amendment via DocuSign and provide ACH details. enablement team needs developer seats unlocked on Monday to run migration tests.
Jordan (Finance): ok — we'll need official vendor remittance details + a W-9 on file to enable ACH. I'll open vendor registration ticket. also we require a deposit (30%) before provisioning beyond trial seats.
Priya (CSM): for provisioning: CE can open 10 dev seats as a soft unlock for migration testing before full provisioning, once deposit clears we can unlock full. @Jordan is 10 seats acceptable?
Jordan (Finance): 10 seats as trial looks fine but mark them as non-production. we need the timeline in writing (dates).
RenewalBot: Reminder — Renewal for Vercity due 2026-03-31; seats: 120; current committed renewal: 12-month term.
Ari (Legal): reviewed draft — minor tweak to clarify invoicing cadence and late fee terms. change line to: "Remaining balance shall be invoiced and payable via ACH within thirty (30) days; late payments subject to standard interest per agreement." otherwise ok. I can add e-sign clause for delegated signer authority.
Priya (CSM): thanks Ari. @Sam Patel can you confirm signers (CFO or delegated AP) and provide vendor banking + W-9 by EOD tomorrow so finance can kick vendor onboarding?
Sam Patel: CFO will sign. I'll upload W-9 and ACH remittance to your portal tonight. can you confirm DocuSign recipient email is cfo@vercity.com?
Priya (CSM): yes that's the email I have. i'll queue the DocuSign once legal confirms final amendment (aim EOD tomorrow). provisioning contingent on deposit, but we can hold 10 dev seats for Monday as agreed.
Jordan (Finance): once W-9 + ACH details are in, finance will provision vendor and release invoice for 30% deposit. ETA for vendor onboarding is 1 business day after docs.
Ari (Legal): sending final amendment redline now. if no objections I'll finalize and route for DocuSign.
Sam Patel: awesome, thanks all. this keeps enablement on track.
Priya (CSM): great — i'll update the renewal playbook with the 70/30 split and attach the amendment. ping me if anything slips. :+1:
